chapters.label: Hangzhou
chapters.text: Hangzhou, China, 2007, a World Cup semi-final. Brazil, in yellow, play the United States. Marta, number ten, has her back to goal. A defender is tight behind her. Here comes the ball. Watch her feet... she scores! Four nil!

chapters.label: Flick and spin
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Marta flicks the ball round one side of the defender, and spins round the other. Then she beats one more, and slots it past the keeper.

chapters.label: One way, the other
chapters.text: When a defender is tight behind you, use a clever touch. Flick the ball one way, and run the other!
